authority: Adrian direct: muted Facebook/Instagram feed readability, talking-head chest captions, prominent persistent branding and essential-subject crop framing

speaker_caption.placement: Stable per-shot upper chest, nearest face without covering chin or mouth. Measure anatomical chin and upper_chest_bbox; detector box bottom is not chin evidence.

notes: House QA baseline derived from Adrian review evidence; it is an internal design acceptance standard, not a guarantee of every Meta surface.
Caption panel is the default b-roll zone; speaker captions follow measured upper chest inside critical.
Bounds include text, backing panel and animation extrema. Inspect decoded video in all three layouts muted.
Chin gap is a broad guard, not proof of chest placement. Caption vertical center must also fall inside measured upper chest.

Primary persistent branding stays fully visible, readable and deliberately composed throughout the reel. A closing endcard does not replace it, and shrinking a corner bug to avoid collisions is not acceptable.
Measure the tight visible mark rather than its backing tile. Human phone-preview review decides actual legibility and prominence; the executable only checks the recorded floor and receipt integrity.
Protect every meaning-bearing face and action through actual crop transforms. Review decoded start, mid, end, motion extrema and transition samples; geometry alone is not a visual pass.

Speaker tracking is checked only inside explicitly declared Adrian A-roll intervals. Every frame remains in the denominator; missing detections, discarded positional outliers and Haar fallback cannot support a pass.

persistent_brand.measurement: Tight visible logo/glyph bounds in the decoded 1080x1920 export, excluding transparent padding and backing tile; scaled to a 360px-wide design-review preview.
persistent_brand.acceptance_basis: Internal SS design floor chosen from a human-reviewed 460x92 panel whose tight mark measured 400x68 at 1080 canvas (133.3x22.7 at 360 preview). It is not a Meta surface guarantee.

essential_subjects.bbox_rule: Measure the full meaning-bearing extent: a face box includes the whole head and hair, not only detector eyes/nose; an action box includes every object/gesture required to understand the beat.
essential_subjects.transform_rule: Bind source_bbox through the actual per-sample source_rect to output_rect transform and verify the calculated output_bbox in portrait, center 4:5 and center square views.
essential_subjects.source_completeness: Mark complete only after viewing the source. Intentional partial framing requires explicit named human editorial acceptance and reason.

speaker_tracking.speaker: Adrian Taffinder
speaker_tracking.measurement: Decode every frame of every declared Adrian A-roll interval. Never include B-roll faces in the measurement. Never discard positional outliers, lower the denominator or substitute Haar/collar boxes. More than one detected face is identity-ambiguous and blocks automated passage.
speaker_tracking.geometry: At each computed start, middle, end, eye extremum and maximum-step frame, bind the whole-head source bbox through the actual source crop and output transform. The full head, hair and eyes must remain visible inside the common critical crop intersection.
speaker_tracking.human_acceptance: A named human reviewer checks the current-export decoded full 9:16, center 4:5 and center square proofs for Adrian identity, full head and eyes, smooth tracking, source-edge feasibility and composition, then completes the normal-speed audiovisual and muted watches. Assistant or automated still review is not the named human watch. Missing detection, proof or human watch blocks release; automated detection does not establish identity, hair completeness or visual quality.
speaker_tracking.acceptance_basis: Internal SS tracking thresholds. They are production acceptance values, not platform guarantees.

demonstration_integrity.source_visual_rule: When understanding depends on seeing the demonstration, its action and viewer response remain source-demonstration video. Supporting B-roll and the 60/40 target cannot cover, replace or fragment those intervals.
demonstration_integrity.overlay_rule: Keep every meaning-bearing hand, prop and action box clear of captions, persistent branding, hooks and labels in portrait, centre 4:5 and centre square crops.
checker_limitations: The executable validates receipt completeness, hashes and declared mappings; it does not watch the video or identify hands, props or actions.
CM-079 crop and collision geometry cannot prove that a demonstration is understandable.
Transcript review and decoded stills do not satisfy actual-video review.
The 60/40 coverage target never overrides essential demonstration continuity.
